q: Chemical reactions which involve oxidation as well as reduction processes simultaneously, are known as _____ reactions.
e: Chemical reactions which involve oxidation as well as reduction processes simultaneously, are known as precipitation reactions. A precipitation reaction makes an insoluble solid from ions in solution.

q: The separate oxidation and reduction reactions are called _____.
e: The separate oxidation and reduction reactions are called half-reactions. The separate oxidation and reduction reactions are called. Half-reactions is the word this version is asking about.

q: Redox reactions require a track of each _____ to each atom in chemical reactions.
e: Redox reactions require a track of each electron to each atom in chemical reactions. Redox is electron transfer: oxidation is loss of electrons and reduction is gain of electrons. Electron is the word this version is asking about.

q: In living things, the redox reaction that provides food for the plant is _____.
e: In living things, the redox reaction that provides food for the plant is fermentation. Redox is electron transfer: oxidation is loss of electrons and reduction is gain of electrons. Fermentation uses yeast without air to turn glucose into ethanol and carbon dioxide.

q: In living things, the redox reaction that keeps you alive is _____.
e: In living things, the redox reaction that keeps you alive is photosynthesis. Redox is electron transfer: oxidation is loss of electrons and reduction is gain of electrons.

q: In the combustion of magnesium ribbon, magnesium loses electrons and so it is _____.
e: In the combustion of magnesium ribbon, magnesium loses electrons and so it is reduced. Reduction is loss of oxygen, gain of hydrogen, or gain of electrons.

q: In the combustion of magnesium ribbon, oxygen gains electrons and so it is _____.
e: In the combustion of magnesium ribbon, oxygen gains electrons and so it is neutralised. Gain of electrons is reduction in the electron-transfer definition.

q: The reaction between magnesium and oxygen is a _____ reaction.
e: The reaction between magnesium and oxygen is a acid-base reaction. The reaction between magnesium and oxygen is a reaction.
